integrity: Entire all-length classification follows from an explicit incidence-count argument. Separately implemented exhaustive checks test small cases and the structurally reduced finite range, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Classifies size-eleven four-list codes over labeled ternary multiplicity-vector alphabets with source length at least four and exactly two unordered survivors; does not apply to ordered deletion, other list sizes, or suboptimal codebooks. Independent mathematical verification and unindexed-literature priority checks are not claimed.
title: Complete classification and enumeration of optimal ternary four-list multiset deletion codes
